title: Bramma
desc: Ravivarman, a sketch artist, loses his beloved wife in a tragic flight accident. When he helps the police track a dangerous criminal, the miscreant vows to seek revenge on Ravivarman.

title: Pethi Sollai Thattathe
desc: A young man, returning home from higher studies, falls in love with a girl whom he meets on the train. Later, they get married and face multiple challenges.

title: Musthaffaa
desc: Periyavar's right-hand man Mustafa and Kavita, a dancer, are set to get married. After Kavita's boss Kaaliya murders her, Mustafa resolves to seek vengeance.

title: Chinna Poove Mella Pesu
desc: Raja challenges Rekha academically and later both fall in love. David, scarred by past tragedy, aids Raja and Rekha against Rekha's ruthless father who once nearly killed him.

title: Subash
desc: Subhash, an unemployed young man, joins the army to be able to marry his lover. However, when he returns from his deployment, he is shocked to see his brother leading a corrupt life.
